title: CAR-005 Environment Snapshot Projection
description: The minimal, purpose-built projection of a synthetic environment, carrying exactly the seven facts resolution consumes (FR-002): available model IDs, alias-to-resolved-model bindings, per-model supported efforts, probe availability, exact-invocation probe outcomes, declared platform route changes for pinned tuples, and the organization model allowlist. It deliberately does NOT reuse the CAR-002 runtime-capability capture-record shape, which carries capture provenance, digests, and retention metadata resolution never reads. Sufficiency is claimed in both directions: every member has a named consuming requirement and no requirement reads a fact this document omits — the consumed-by mapping is recorded in data-model.md section 2. schema_version is the one member with no resolution consumer; it is document identity, carried by every document in this directory, never read by the walk. The projection is of CAR-002's frozen observation on the subagent_frontmatter surface, and the mapping is one-way and total on the CAR-002 side (FR-002a): hard_rejection lands on exact_invocation_probe failure, soft_remap on a platform_route_changes entry, and undetermined on probe_availability false — never on probe success, because an observation from which no availability claim derives is at least as weak as an absent probe. No $ref appears anywhere in this document (FR-016).

available_models.description: FR-006 model_absent: the resolved model IDs the environment offers. Disjoint from available_models_allowlist — this is what the environment offers, that is what the organization permits.

alias_bindings.description: FR-006: alias to resolved model ID. An absent key is alias_unresolved; a key bound to a model other than the one the route pins is alias_repointed. An open-keyed MAP, not a record: the keys are per-case synthetic aliases, so additionalProperties carries the value schema and is never false — false would reject every entry, since each data key is by definition an additional property, making this document unsatisfiable for any non-empty snapshot. propertyNames constrains the keys instead, so an empty-string alias is rejected at validation rather than becoming a silently unmatchable entry. The key set cannot be closed to an enum: a cross-document constraint tying snapshot keys to policy values is not expressible here.

supported_efforts.description: FR-007 effort_unsupported: model ID to the efforts that model supports. Per-model effort support is a documented platform constraint, not an invention — the subagent effort field's option list carries the qualifier that available levels depend on the model. The ladder is re-declared inline here because a cross-document $ref is prohibited in this directory (FR-016); the route-policy schema's own copy is the one FR-007a's set-equality test reads.

probe_availability.description: FR-008 capability_probe_unavailable: model ID to whether capability probing is available. An explicit false is used wherever a probe is unavailable, never an absent key, because FR-008 forbids treating probe absence as probe success and an absent key is exactly the ambiguity that invites it. This is also where CAR-002's undetermined outcome lands (FR-002a).

exact_invocation_probe.description: FR-009 treatment_probe_failed and FR-011's clean success: model ID to the exact-invocation outcome. failure is where CAR-002's hard_rejection lands; success and absent are this projection's own values for the cases CAR-002's unavailable-model probe never reaches — a probe that ran against an available model and succeeded, and no exact-invocation outcome recorded at all.

platform_route_changes.description: FR-006 platform_route_changed, and where CAR-002's soft_remap lands (FR-002a). An ARRAY of two-field records rather than a map, so each record closes with additionalProperties false; uniqueItems is set because a pinned tuple listed twice would carry no additional meaning. This member is what gives the platform_route_changed sub-reason something to evaluate: its predicate is 'the snapshot declares a platform-side route change for the pinned tuple'.

available_models_allowlist.description: FR-024b's override-skip branch: the models the organization permits, which the documented runtime checks an override value against before skipping one that resolves to an excluded model. An ordered-irrelevant set, so uniqueItems is set and no per-item closure is needed. minItems 0 is declared because the empty array is meaningful and load-bearing in the same way probe_availability's explicit false is: [] means the environment genuinely permits nothing, so an environment with no allowlist configured carries every model it makes available rather than encoding the unrestricted case as [] and inverting the meaning.
